arguments.prompt:
Create NEW NATIVE HAND-DRAWN detailed pixel-art animation drawings of adult GORDON FREEMAN from HALF-LIFE 2 (2004). Use the supplied old local sheet for his FACE and HEV OUTFIT ONLY. Its invented minigun/yellow beam are WRONG and MUST NOT be copied. Same white adult scientist, short brown hair, short brown GOATEE, rectangular BLACK GLASSES in every pose. Proper HEV MARK V suit: ORANGE chest/abdomen/thigh/shin armor with lambda chest emblem, black under-suit/joints, charcoal/gray shoulder/arm armor, gray-black full tactical gloves and dark armored boots. No helmet, bare chest, orange skin, medieval armor or giant robot proportions. Normal SIMPLE attack is an actual RED steel CROWBAR with a curved hooked silver/red end, physically gripped; no crowbar energy wave. Normal SECONDARY is the ORANGE HL2 Zero Point Energy Field Manipulator / Gravity Gun with iconic three front prongs, held in TWO connected gloved hands. A small captured metal prop is a project adaptation of prop punt, not a living body. Its release does not create a laser. The separate dedicated32 SUPER uses the BLUE Citadel-overcharged Gravity Gun and captured Combine energy sphere; BLUE super gun and sphere do NOT appear on these full45 ordinary rows. No HL1 Gluon Gun, minigun, rocket launcher, magic fist, superhero body beam, extra arm, enemy, corpse, blood or gore. Weapons only appear where the row explicitly requests them. During free-hand movement/guard/ledge rows the crowbar and Gravity Gun are securely stowed behind the suit, not stuck through wrists or palms. No unrelated props or scenery.

CRITICAL NATIVE GRID: transparent RGBA background. NO labels, text, grid lines, borders, floor, scenery, drop shadows, smoke or decorative VFX. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS. Each state below is a dedicated row of exactly FOUR complete and anatomically DIFFERENT drawings in chronological order LEFT→RIGHT. Do not omit a row. Full character including shoes, coat tails, fingers, elbows, crowbar/prongs must stay INSIDE its own cell with generous transparent gutters. No figure touches another figure, canvas border or adjacent row. Every hand connects through wrist/forearm/elbow to the correct shoulder, exactly two arms/two legs. Right-facing by default. Use the SAME upright crown-to-sole anatomical size throughout the entire source; bent crouches, tucked jumps, hanging legs and lying KO bodies keep their naturally shorter projected height, NEVER expanded to fill cells. Upright bodies leave20percent safety room for extended arms/weapons. Four distinct joint/foot/torso configurations per row, not repeated pictures with color/effect changes. Native pixel clusters with readable shading, not smeared vector art. Whole final row required. Original adapted choreography, not an extracted official film/game sprite or certified 1:1 source animation.

EXACTLY EIGHT dedicated rows,4columns ×8rows =32NATIVE bodies. Tall portrait aspect1:2 (target proportional layout1024×2048). Do NOT compress to seven rows. All hands FREE; weapons stowed for this movement atlas.
ROW1 idle: grounded alert stance, four breathing/weight-shift keys changing knees, shoulders and empty-hand readiness, clear complete standing calibration body in c0.
ROW2 walk: rightward contact/down/passing/up stride cycle, alternating feet and empty arms, four different body keys.
ROW3 run: rightward sprint, four alternating extended/tucked legs, forward torso lean and pumping free arms; clothing follows body naturally.
ROW4 turn: c0 facing LEFT -> c1 left-rear three-quarter -> c2 right-rear three-quarter -> c3 clearly facing RIGHT. Real foot/hip/head/torso rotation, never duplicate mirrored drawings.
ROW5 jumpStart: c0 BOTH feet GROUNDED upright settling -> c1 BOTH feet GROUNDED in deep anticipation crouch -> c2 actual leg extension/heavy toe push-off -> c3 BOTH feet clearly airborne and knees start tucking. Do not begin with four airborne bodies.
ROW6 jumpRise: four distinct rising airborne keys, knees and elbows tuck then adjust, free arms balance and torso lifts. Full shoes and hands.
ROW7 jumpApex: four different upper-jump suspension bodies with changing knee/hip/arm angles -> boots start lowering for descent. This is a separate complete row, not omitted.
ROW8 fall: four descending body keys, boots lower and knees load gradually for landing, arms free and full limbs contained. Whole last row.
